title: MZ How do I get the default name input processing back in VisuStella?

posts.author: tortil
posts.body: I think the original stock RPG Maker MZ name input processing fits my game a lot more then the visustella one, but I cant find any settings

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Doesn't it work if you copy the Scene_Name stuff and add it as a plugin after VS?
EDIT: Or actually, you can in Core Engine settings->Keyboard Input - Name Input, set Enable to false and Default Mode to default.
